newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga to spend six bln rgt on new plant.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga to spend six bln rgt on new plant.

text.p: Malaysia's power utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd will spend an estimated 6.0 billion ringgit to develop its proposed 2,000-megawatt power plant and coal yard in Perak state, local newspapers reported on Saturday.
To be fully completed by the year 2002, the entire project cost will be borne by TNB Janamanjung Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tenaga.

"We will raise the necessary funding and we are now looking at the best financial arrangement...through equity but mostly through direct financing," Tenaga executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali was quoted as saying by the Business Times.
Tajuddin said the first phase of the plant will be completed in 1998.
"The margin of this plant (in terms of capacity) will be 35 percent," he said.
